description_en: Creates a model, which is a collection of model versions. You must specify information such as the model name and description
description_zh: 创建模型。模型是模型版本的集合，创建模型时需要指定模型名称，描述等信息
kebab_example: aliyun aiworkspace create-model --model-name News_classification --labels example-string --tag example-string --model-description News_classification. --workspace-id 79600 --accessibility PRIVATE --origin ModelScope --domain nlp --task text-classification --model-doc https://0.md --order-number 0 --model-type Checkpoint --extra-info '{"RatingCount":2866,"Rating":4.94,"FavoriteCount":34992,"CommentCount":754,"CoverUris":["https://e000u.oss-cn-hangzhou.aliyuncs.com/drea000w.png"],"TippedAmountCount":32,"DownloadCount":606056}' --parameter-size 3000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateModel

parameters.help_en:
The visibility of the model in the workspace. Valid values:

PRIVATE (default): The model is visible only to you and administrators in the workspace.

PUBLIC: The model is visible to everyone in the workspace
parameters.help_zh:
工作空间可见度，取值如下。
PRIVATE（默认值）：在此工作空间中，仅对您和管理员可见。
PUBLIC：在此工作空间中，对所有人可见
parameters.name: accessibility

parameters.help_en: The domain. This describes the field that the model is designed for, such as nlp (Natural Language Processing) or cv (computer vision)
parameters.help_zh: 领域。描述模型解决问题所属领域。例如：nlp（自然语言处理）、cv（计算机视觉）等
parameters.name: domain

fields.help_en: The label key. The value can be up to 128 bytes in length and cannot contain equal signs (=) and commas (,)
fields.help_zh: 标签的key。最长128 字节，不支持等于号（=）与半角逗号（,）
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The label value. The value can be up to 128 bytes in length and cannot contain equal signs (=) and commas (,)
fields.help_zh: 标签的value。最长128 字节，不支持等于号（=）与半角逗号（,）
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: A list of labels. This parameter is deprecated and is replaced by the Tag parameter
parameters.help_zh: 标签列表。将废弃，由Tag字段取代
parameters.name: labels

parameters.help_en: The description of the model. Use this to distinguish different models
parameters.help_zh: 模型描述，用于区分不同的模型
parameters.name: model_description

parameters.help_en: The name of the model. The name must be 1 to 127 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 模型名称，长度为1~127个字符
parameters.name: model_name

parameters.help_en: The model type, such as Checkpoint or LoRA
parameters.name: model_type

parameters.help_en: The ordinal number of the model. You can use this for custom sorting
parameters.help_zh: 模型序号。可用于自定义排序
parameters.name: order_number

parameters.help_en: The source of the model. This specifies the community or organization that the source model belongs to, such as ModelScope and HuggingFace
parameters.help_zh: 模型源。描述源模型所属社区或组织，如ModelScope，HuggingFace等
parameters.name: origin

parameters.help_en: The number of parameters, in millions
parameters.name: parameter_size

fields.help_en: The label key. The value can be up to 128 bytes in length and cannot contain equal signs (=) and commas (,)
fields.help_zh: 标签的key。最长128 字节，不支持等于号（=）与半角逗号（,）
fields.name: key

fields.help_en: The label value. The value can be up to 128 bytes in length and cannot contain equal signs (=) and commas (,)
fields.help_zh: 标签的value。最长128 字节，不支持等于号（=）与半角逗号（,）
fields.name: value

parameters.help_en: The task. This describes the specific problem that the model solves, such as text-classification (text classification)
parameters.help_zh: 任务。描述模型解决的具体问题。例如：text-classification（文本分类）等
parameters.name: task

parameters.help_en: The ID of the workspace. For more information about how to obtain a workspace ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.help_zh: 工作空间ID。如何获取工作空间ID，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/449124.html
parameters.name: workspace_id
